_about: Every number plotted in figures/ comes from this file. Each block names the paper, table and what the number means, so a reader can check it against the source.

mem0_locomo.source: Chhikara et al., Mem0: Building Production-Ready AI Agents with Scalable Long-Term Memory, arXiv:2504.19413, Table 2
mem0_locomo.metric: Overall LLM-as-a-Judge score J on LoCoMo (higher is better) and total p95 latency in seconds

zep_longmemeval.source: Rasmussen et al., Zep: A Temporal Knowledge Graph Architecture for Agent Memory, arXiv:2501.13956, Table 2 (LongMemEval_S)

harness_user_centric_qwen3_32b.source: Huang et al., Harness the Memory: A Holistic Evaluation of Memory Substrates in Memory Agents, arXiv:2608.15008v2, Table 1 (Qwen3-32B-AWQ backbone)
harness_user_centric_qwen3_32b.metric: LLM-judge score P4 (0-1, higher is better)

harness_locomo_latency_qwen3_8b.source: arXiv:2608.15008v2, Table 1 (Qwen3-8B backbone), LoCoMo P4 and per-query latency E15 in seconds

harness_agent_centric_qwen3_32b.source: arXiv:2608.15008v2, Table 2 (Qwen3-32B-AWQ). ALFWorld task success rate (%) and BigCodeBench-Hard Pass@1 (%)

mccl_stateful_minus_reset.source: Li et al., Memory-Centric Continual Learning for AI Agents, arXiv:2610.29357, Sec. 4.3 (IdeaBench sequential deployment, Mem0 at an 8,192-token cap)
mccl_stateful_minus_reset.metric: Stateful score minus reset score, in points (positive = memory helps)

mccl_reader_policies.source: arXiv:2610.29357, Table 4 (LoCoMo, 9 conversations, 180 questions, Mem0 memory banks)

merit_hard_tier.source: Mishra and Mishra, When Does Memory Help? A Cost-Aware Evaluation of Long-Term Memory in Tool-Using LLM Agents (MERIT), arXiv:2609.05441, hard tier (fact updated mid-arc), real implementations, gpt-4.1-mini
merit_hard_tier.metric: Dependent-task success rate (0-1). No-memory scores 0.00 everywhere.

always_on_corpus.source: Ding et al., Always-On Agents: A Survey of Persistent Memory, State, and Governance in LLM Agents, arXiv:2606.30306. Lifecycle coding of 435 works (multi-label)

aoep_v0_pilot.source: arXiv:2606.30306, Table 18 (AOEP-v0 pilot, nine fault patterns, Qwen2.5-7B reader)
aoep_v0_pilot.metric: Obligations passed (of 15) and negative invariants passed (of 41)
